setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
k = rng.integers(0, 6, 20000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (6, 30))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (20000, 30)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(30)])
df['cluster'] = [f'c{v}' for v in k]
df['score'] = df['x0'] * 2 + rng.normal(0, 1, 20000)
pythonApiCode: import positron_atlas as atlas; m = atlas.open(df); m.color_by('score'); m.save_png('/tmp/positron-atlas-e2e/api.png')

steps.name: save_png wrote the map (not a blank image)
color_by(score) applied (not the default colour column)
let the selection message reach the kernel (it is handled between cells)
a command from a later cell (comm latency once the tab exists)
